calls.title: Ryan / Jake
calls.summary: Strategies discussed include launching targeted customer campaigns aimed at enhancing outreach to existing growth accounts and event attendees, spearheaded by team members like Matt and Jake. A Q1 promotion offering 50% off user costs aims to drive upgrades from Pro to Enterprise, with messaging tailored to high-usage customers. The team also plans to leverage segmented target account lists within sectors like gaming and fintech for effective outreach, while integrating email, LinkedIn, and calls to improve lead management. The collaborative environment fosters swift problem-solving and alignment on priorities, with a focus on leveraging the upcoming Pandemonium event to create engagement opportunities.
calls.keywords: Apollo credits, Pro to Enterprise upgrade, Customer growth campaigns, Target account outreach, Competitor intelligence, Messaging refinement
